name: UploadFileToAIModel
label: Upload File to Server
description: Uploads a file to a web API endpoint using multipart/form-data and returns the uploaded file ID .

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: Full path to the file to upload (e.g., C:\temp\document.pdf).

fields.name: ApiUrl
fields.label: API Endpoint URL
fields.description: The target API URL for uploading the file (e.g., https://api.example.com/upload-doc).

fields.name: BearerToken
fields.label: Bearer Token
fields.description: JWT Bearer token for authentication (e.g., eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...).

fields.name: UploadedFileId
fields.label: Uploaded File Id
fields.description: Unique ID extracted from the uploaded file path (e.g., 42a6b659-6f53-478e-9299-dbec2216fad2).

fields.name: ResponseCode
fields.label: Response Code
fields.description: HTTP status code returned by the server.

fields.name: ResponseMessage
fields.label: Response Message
fields.description: Message returned from the upload operation.
